metadata.title: File Sharing and Sync

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for sharing, synchronizing, and collaboratively managing files while preserving access control, integrity, and lifecycle governance.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Collaborative file storage, synchronization clients, sharing links, version control, and cloud-based document repositories.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing collaborative file access, sharing, synchronization, and lifecycle control.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: File sharing and sync trust depends on baseline collaboration identity, boundary control, and accountability.

metadata.remarks: File Sharing and Sync defines trust properties required to safely share and synchronize files in collaborative environments. This pattern addresses access scope, link-based sharing, version integrity, external access, and residual risk from cached or orphaned content.

components.title: File Access and Sharing Scope Control
components.description: Constrains who may access shared files and the scope of permissions granted.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid accounts to access shared files.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Misuse of trusted sharing relationships for unauthorized access.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Role-based access control to limit file sharing permissions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Access to shared files is explicitly managed and reviewed.
File sharing permissions follow least privilege.

components.title: Link-Based Sharing Risk Management
components.description: Controls risk introduced by public or semi-public file sharing links.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Data transfer via shared links outside intended controls.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy enforcement to constrain inappropriate sharing mechanisms.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Policies define acceptable use of link-based file sharing.
Controls reduce the risk of sensitive data exposure through sharing links.

components.title: File Version Integrity and Conflict Management
components.description: Preserves integrity of files as they are edited, synchronized, and versioned.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unauthorized modification of shared or synchronized files.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Integrity checking and version control to prevent silent modification.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integrity mechanisms protect shared file content.
Unnecessary synchronization features are disabled to reduce conflict and drift.

components.title: Sync Client and Residual Data Risk Management
components.description: Manages risk introduced by offline copies and synchronized endpoints.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Collection of data from synced or cached file copies.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle controls to reduce residual risk from cached or orphaned content.

implemented-requirements.remarks: File synchronization features are constrained to reduce data sprawl.
Policies define expectations for local copies of shared files.

components.title: File Sharing Observability and Accountability
components.description: Provides visibility into file access, sharing actions, and lifecycle events.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deletion or suppression of evidence related to file misuse.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging to support investigation and accountability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: File access and sharing events are captured.
Audit review supports oversight of file sharing behavior.
